stories.title: Seven-foot statues, Porsches and real estate: How WNBA players are spending their new millions
stories.summary: From cars and watches to investments and property, here's how WNBA players are using their life-changing new money.

stories.title: Sources: Stad buys lead stake in T-Wolves, Lynx
stories.summary: American businessman Marc Stad has purchased and taken a controlling interest in the NBA's Minnesota Timberwolves and WNBA's Minnesota Lynx.

stories.title: Paredes among Argentines banned for WC brawl
stories.summary: Three Argentina players have been banned for their part in a brawl at the end of last month's World Cup final against Spain, but the South American nation has been fined only for displaying a Falkland Islands banner after the semifinal win over England.

stories.title: Court decision gives NCAA win in eligibility appeal
stories.summary: In a legal victory for the NCAA, a federal appeals court has temporarily halted a court order that would have granted thousands of athletes who left college an extra year of eligibility.

stories.title: Kurt Busch shares last moments with brother Kyle
stories.summary: NASCAR Hall of Famer Kurt Busch made an emotional recollection of the final day he spent at his younger brother's hospital bedside in his first public comments about Kyle Busch's death.
